observations: Photo 0 shows a white and black PlayStation 5 console with the front cover open, revealing a small screen with a purple icon. A white and black DualSense controller is placed in front of it. A coiled black cable is wrapped in plastic next to the console.

Photo 1 shows the same console from a side angle, with the black side panel visible. The same controller and cable are present. The console appears to be in good physical condition with no visible damage.
The console has a glossy black side panel with ventilation slits and a small screen on the front cover. The controller has the standard PlayStation button layout with a touchpad and analog sticks.
The cable appears to be a USB-C to USB-A cable, coiled and wrapped in plastic, with a red power adapter attached.
No FIFA disc game or accessories are visible in either photo.
The console is not shown powered on or connected to a display.

claims.claim: Sony PlayStation 5 console and controller available.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 1 clearly show the console and controller.

claims.claim: It comes with FIFA disc game and accessories.
claims.evidence: No FIFA disc game or additional accessories are visible in either photo. The only accessories shown are the cable and power adapter.

risks.risk: The console may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and playing a game.

risks.risk: The controller may be non-functional or have dead buttons or analog sticks.
risks.proof: A video showing the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses and analog stick movement.

risks.risk: The FIFA disc game may be missing or not included.
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the FIFA disc game in its case or on the console screen.

risks.risk: The cable and power adapter may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A close-up photo or video of the cable and adapter, showing no fraying or damage, and a test of the connection.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cable/adapter may not work

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Video of the controller connecting and responding to inputs.
Photo or video of the FIFA disc game.
Close-up photo or video of the cable and power adapter.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
